requirements_summary: Workload: user-facing chat + occasional bulk doc indexing (embeddings).
Latency target: p50 < 300ms for short-chat queries; p95 target < 1s if possible.
Throughput & concurrency: baseline concurrent chats ~10-20; promotional bursts up to ~150-200 concurrent requests observed in POC.
Token budget: expect ~50-120k tokens/minute during bursts (short messages + context).
Rate-limiting expectations: want soft quotas that allow short bursts (burst window ~60s) and clear headers for remaining quota / reset.
Desired behavior on throttling: graceful degradation (queueing or lightweight fallback), deterministic 429 Retry-After header, and guidance on client backoff.
